title: eugenia batavorum
intro: Eugenia batavorum, commonly known as Javan plum or Java plum, is a tropical fruit-bearing plant native to the Indonesian island of Java. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. Eugenia batavorum's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate appetite, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
